memories.author: D03
memories.text: Routine review of osteoporosis and epilepsy. PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports no new seizures, mild back discomfort on exertion, otherwise well. EXAMINATION: BP 128/78 mmHg, weight 78 kg, height 1.68 m, BMI 27.6 (obese). Advised on diet and activity. Spine tender at L2-L3, no neurological deficit. IMPRESSION: 1) Osteoporosis, on alendronate and calcium/vit D, stable. 2) Epilepsy, levetiracetam 500 mg BD and lamotrigine 50 mg BD, seizure-free for 8 months. ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current meds. Order fasting lipid profile, fasting glucose, serum calcium, 25‑OH vitamin D, sodium, creatinine. DEXA scan and EEG scheduled. Return if: new seizures, worsening back pain, fever >39°C, chest pain, breathlessness, or blood in stools.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Alendronate 70 mg PO once weekly
Calcium carbonate 500 mg PO BD
Cholecalciferol (vit D3) 400 IU PO BD
Levetiracetam 500 mg PO BD
Lamotrigine 50 mg PO BD

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Fasting glucose 92 mg/dL (70‑99)
Fasting LDL 138 mg/dL (<100 optimal), HDL 42 mg/dL (>40 male), Triglycerides 162 mg/dL (<150)
Serum calcium 9.4 mg/dL (8.5‑10.5)
Serum 25‑OH vitamin D 18 ng/mL (30‑100)
Serum sodium 138 mmol/L (135‑145)
Serum creatinine 0.9 mg/dL (0.6‑1.2)

memories.author: D03
memories.text: DEXA scan lumbar spine L1‑L4: T‑score ‑2.6 at L2, consistent with osteoporosis. No vertebral fracture visualized.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: EEG: Background activity normal, no epileptiform discharges or spike‑wave complexes. No evidence of seizure focus.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Follow‑up after 4 months. PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports occasional mild leg cramps, no seizures, back pain unchanged. EXAMINATION: BP 130/80 mmHg, weight 77.5 kg, BMI 27.4 (obese). Advised on diet and activity. No new focal neurology. IMPRESSION: Osteoporosis stable; vitamin D low, need supplementation. Epilepsy well‑controlled. ARRANGEMENTS: Increase cholecalciferol to 1000 IU BD, re‑check calcium and vitamin D in 8 weeks. Continue other meds. Return if: new seizures, severe muscle pain, fever >39°C, chest pain, breathlessness, or blood in stools.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Quarterly review. PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient denies seizures, reports improved back comfort, occasional fatigue. EXAMINATION: BP 127/79 mmHg, weight 77 kg, BMI 27.2 (obese). Advised on diet and activity. No deformities. IMPRESSION: Osteoporosis stable; vitamin D still borderline, consider higher dose. Epilepsy unchanged, medication adherence good. ARRANGEMENTS: Increase cholecalciferol to 2000 IU BD, re‑check vitamin D in 3 months. Order fasting lipid profile and fasting glucose for annual review. Continue alendronate, calcium, levetiracetam, lamotrigine. Return if: new seizures, worsening pain, fever >39°C, chest pain, breathlessness, or blood in stools.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Six‑month follow‑up. PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports one brief generalized tonic‑clonic seizure two weeks ago, lasting <2 minutes, post‑ictal confusion resolved. No injuries. Back pain mild. EXAMINATION: BP 129/81 mmHg, weight 78 kg, BMI 27.6 (obese). Advised on diet and activity. No focal deficit. IMPRESSION: Osteoporosis stable. Epilepsy: breakthrough seizure, consider dose adjustment of levetiracetam. ARRANGEMENTS: Increase levetiracetam to 750 mg BD, keep lamotrigine 50 mg BD. Check serum creatinine and sodium in 4 weeks. Continue alendronate, calcium, vitamin D 2000 IU BD. Return if: seizure recurrence, prolonged post‑ictal state, fever >39°C, chest pain, breathlessness, or blood in stools.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Routine check‑up. PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient seizure‑free since medication increase, reports good energy, mild occasional back stiffness. EXAMINATION: BP 128/80 mmHg, weight 77.5 kg, BMI 27.4 (obese). Advised on diet and activity. No neurological signs. IMPRESSION: Osteoporosis stable; vitamin D level adequate on current dose. Epilepsy well‑controlled on levetiracetam 750 mg BD and lamotrigine 50 mg BD. ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current meds. Order repeat DEXA scan in 12 months. Return if: new seizures, worsening back pain, fever >39°C, chest pain, breathlessness, or blood in stools.
